plain_result: Clef did not meet the fixed requirements for using outcome feedback to select between two useful learned organs. It beat global reliability and a fixed-organ baseline, but did worse with true outcomes than with outcomes hidden and was far worse than explicit capability-specific reliability. The held-out controller phase did not run.

organs: Energy model with probabilities from softmax of negative energy
design.training_objective: Both organs used categorical cross-entropy. Their complementary reliability was induced by different training coverage, not established as inherent architecture specialties.
design.representation_changes: Module aliases and display order changed together.
design.full_information: The controller saw both organs' forecast vectors and historical outcomes; current outcomes were evaluator-only.
design.repeated_unit_limit: 128 responses reuse16 queries in4 related world families; they are not128 independent tasks.

metric.name: Expected selected-organ sum Brier loss
metric.formula: Sum over organs of selection probability times that organ's sum-of-squared probability error against the observed next state.
metric.aggregation: Average within family and capability across the two queries and both representations, then equally across capabilities and families.

representation_check.interpretation: Joint alias/order sensitivity; this does not isolate a name-only cause.

checks.composite_archive_audit: PASS; scientific gate false is a valid negative result.
checks.independence_limit: Supplemental provenance and accounting were independently implemented; the frozen scientific metric code was reused by its original author. Separate source review was performed.
checks.extra_terminal_review: PASS; source, archive, lifecycle and attempt-accounting review.

extra_numerical_recount.scope: Separately implemented calculation within the project, not an external replication.

limits: Development result only; no held-out controller confirmation.
The continuation was adopted after a provider failure and is explicitly separate from the original no-retry protocol.
Hosted weights were not pinned across the collection gap; input-dependent availability or serving changes cannot be ruled out.
History-label swaps are corrupted-attribution controls, not new real trajectories.
Training coverage created the organ reliability contrast; both architectures used the same classification objective.
The richer-coverage organ had trained on the queried state-action transitions. This tests access to existing learned knowledge, not both organs generalizing to unseen transitions.
No internal credit representation or causal circuit was measured.
No energy-model superiority, new-rule transfer, multi-step planning or novelty is established.
next_candidate: Use explicit per-capability reliability memory, then test where it fails or generalizes when abilities change in fresh settings. This suggestion does not launch a new experiment.
transformation: Selected complete development aggregates, fixed method, disclosed continuation and limits. No raw answers, per-query probabilities, private account data, process identifiers, credentials, or absolute machine paths copied. Earlier public summary records remain unchanged.
